purpose: Provide real run, windup, strike, and recovery poses for the retained Dasher A identity in five-minute-overdrive gameplay.
camera: fixed top-down three-quarter orthographic game camera pitched approximately 45 degrees
facing: six right-facing action masters; flip horizontally at runtime when the player is to the left
lighting: controlled cyan rim light with restrained magenta emission and an alpha-based runtime contrast outline
prompt: Turn the approved Dasher A compact humanoid tactical sprinter into a strict 3 by 2 animation sheet: three real run poses followed by windup, forward strike, and recovery; preserve identity, volume, right-facing 45-degree camera, opaque armor core, clean alpha, and consistent scale.
negative_constraints: no whole-body spin, simple scale-only animation, identity drift, camera drift, or duplicate pose
no weapon, projectile, motion trail, environment, text, watermark, cropped anatomy, extra limbs, or detached parts
do not change collision, speed, health, damage, AI, attack timing, or behavior
generation_model: imagegen built-in plus deterministic connected-background removal and six-component grid repacking
